title: Joe's band rehearsing at the family home
summary: Joe's band, with Benny Carter at times, rehearsed at the house and then left for New York; Roy was still unsure about music.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: No, no, it was regular legit theatre. Yeah. Then my brother, he came back home... No, before they left to go to New York. That's right. They used to rehearse at our house. And I used to put them down, because... And I think I was right, too -- although I didn't know I was right then. What they used to do, they'd... Well, they'd shake up the neighborhood, of course. It was a hell of a band. Eli Sarnees(?) (?) with the band once, and also Benny Carter. And they'd rehearse over a couple of numbers, and then they'd play one of their shouts, you know -- really tear the neighborhood up. Then the food. My mother had food for them, and big pots full, and these cats would eat like dogs, man. I told my mother, "(?)'s coming over to play because of that food!" Heh-heh.
So that band went to New York?
Yeah, they went to New York. Yeah, they went.... Joe stayed in New York. He came home once, man, and he had his coat(?) ...(?)...(?)...(?)...(?)...
You were still not sure that you wanted to be a musician?
